name: Careers
overview: Scripture teaches that careers should be approached with diligence, wisdom, and a heart committed to the Lord. By delighting in God and committing our work to Him, our efforts are established and our desires aligned with His will. The diligent person is honored and stands before leaders, while wisdom and understanding are foundational to building and sustaining any endeavor. Ultimately, we are called to work wholeheartedly, recognizing that earthly labor is a precious opportunity not available beyond this life.
